issues.description: Stock.getStockIngredients() has different return types across template and solution. In the template, it is declared as `public List<StockIngredient> getStockIngredients()`, while in the solution it is `public StockIngredient[] getStockIngredients()`. This API mismatch changes how students can iterate/access the inventory and will break code written against the template when compared to the reference solution/tests (and vice versa).
issues.suggestedFix: Make Stock.getStockIngredients() consistent across all artifacts. Prefer returning `StockIngredient[]` in both template and solution (fits the array-based helper approach), i.e., change the template signature/body to `public StockIngredient[] getStockIngredients()` and return the backing array; alternatively change the solution to return `List<StockIngredient>` and update all usages/tests accordingly.
